title: Correct expression for s
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the distance between adjacent bullets in the air must be (v0 + v1)Δt0.

title: Correct expression for Δt
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the time interval between hits must be (v0 + v1)Δt0 / (v0 - v2).

title: Relative motion for s
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly combine the bullet's ground speed and Cart A's motion to find the separation s.

title: Relative motion for Δt
description: Important: The reasoning must set up the relative closing speed between bullet and Cart B to relate s and Δt.

title: Consistent frame analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly use the ground frame for distances/speeds or clearly justify relative motion steps.

title: Unit or dimensional check
description: Optional: The student may perform a dimensional analysis to verify the expressions for s and Δt.

title: Sign error in relative speed
description: Pitfall: Using (v0 + v2) instead of (v0 - v2) for the relative speed of bullet approaching Cart B.

title: Ignoring Cart A's motion
description: Pitfall: Stating s = v0Δt0, incorrectly neglecting the motion of the firing cart.
